text:
mike: FYI discovered a subtle contract change in embeddings endpoint after the v2->v3 header harmonization. Previously we returned `embedding_size` in response metadata; v3 moved to `dims` to match internal naming. Broke a few dashboards expecting `embedding_size`.

tara: oh man. is this only telemetry metadata or used in downstream code?

mike: dashboards + a couple of internal pipelines use it. customer-facing SDKs surfaced it too.

oleg: short fix: accept both keys in response generator for a deprecation window, emit `embedding_meta.deprecated_key_used=true` telemetry when `embedding_size` requested. plan: support both for 90 days then remove `embedding_size` after notice.

zoe: add feature flag `RESPONSE_EMBEDDING_KEYS=both|dims_only|legacy` env var for private installs. Also add header `X-Redwood-Compat: embedding-meta=legacy|modern`.

infra-bot: deploy queued: canary/emb-keys-dual -> staging at 171777...

mike: tests: unit ensuring both keys present, SDK patch to read fallback key, migration note in changelog. tara please coordinate with SDK team.

tara: will do. I'll open a PR in sdks and link this thread.

oleg: done. simple middleware change. i'll include a metric `emb_meta.key_fallback_ratio` aggregated daily.

mike: acceptance: 2 canaries green, SDK update released, email to customers with top-affected tenants.

zoe: track in INF-4822. mike will own communication.

mike: thanks all. I'll PR in the next hour.
